modmenu.descriptionTranslation.triple_sw: Execute triple weapon swapping to combine start attributes, reach weapon range, and end weapon damage.
text.triple_swapping.title: Triple Swapping Configuration
tooltip.triple_swapping.enabled: Master toggle for the triple swapping mechanics.
tooltip.triple_swapping.trigger_mode:
Choose when triple swapping is triggered:
• Only When Target > 3 Blocks: Seamless mode; only swaps if target is out of normal range (3.0-4.5 blocks)
• On Attack: Always swaps on attack
• Dedicated Keybind: Swaps on pressing the execute key (default: R)
• Hold Trigger Key: Swaps when attacking while holding the key
tooltip.triple_swapping.slot_mode:
Choose how weapons are located in your inventory:
• Fixed Hotbar Slot: Uses explicit hotbar slots (1-9)
• Auto-Detect Item in Hotbar: Dynamically searches hotbar for matching item IDs
tooltip.triple_swapping.start_slot: Hotbar slot index for the start item (Sword). Provides start-of-tick attributes like base damage & attack speed.
tooltip.triple_swapping.reach_slot: Hotbar slot index for the intermediate item (Spear/Trident). Provides extended targeted entity reach.
tooltip.triple_swapping.attack_slot: Hotbar slot index for the finishing weapon (Mace). Applies enchantments and impact smash damage.
tooltip.triple_swapping.start_item_id: Item ID or keyword to search for the start attribute weapon (e.g., 'minecraft:diamond_sword').
tooltip.triple_swapping.reach_item_id: Item ID or keyword to search for the reach weapon (e.g., 'spear' or 'minecraft:trident').
tooltip.triple_swapping.attack_item_id: Item ID or keyword to search for the finishing weapon (e.g., 'minecraft:mace').
tooltip.triple_swapping.reach_distance: The simulated reach distance in blocks during client-side target calculation (default: 4.5 blocks).
tooltip.triple_swapping.client_delay: Delay window in milliseconds for the slot transition packets (default: 50ms = 1 game tick).
tooltip.triple_swapping.hud_indicator: Displays a non-intrusive status indicator on the game HUD showing mode and active slot chain.
